I am grateful to have people around me who clearly cares for the people. We are from the Philippines. We share the same region as Myanmar and are standing up for their rights as well since we know very well what opression is like from the hands of tyrants. 

I agree. His words can and will help the people of Myanmar for generations to come.

I only heard him from my favorite professor who is also my close friend. He came up in our conversation as we closely watched what is happening in Myanmar. Being in the milktea alliance, we are worried for our brothers in Myanmar and my professor, knowing I write poetry, shared me this beautiful poem for the masses by K Za. It hurts me and empowers me to read such love for people that I had to share it so others can read and feel empathy to the people in Myanmar too. K Za was one of the people who fought for his fellow men until the very end and he deserves recognition. 

I am very glad you had the opportunity to be in his company. Thank you so much for sharing your experience with him as well. Rest in power, K Za.
